purpose: Draft D8c2a base-level screen ledger (#290): under the frozen D3 conjugate-boundary relation, support 2/3 bases have lower mean K than one-axis bases at lengths 3-5, and the null model matches ZFA continuation sets exactly on all 37,376 bases. D8c2 was not run.

entries.claim: For bases of length 3, 4, and 5 with extension bound 3 under the D3 conjugate-boundary join, mean continuation-class count K is lower for support 2/3 bases than for support 1 bases at every length. The net-zero null model produces exactly the same continuation sets as ZFA on all 37,376 bases (0 differences).
entries.formal_scope: Finite twist words of length 3-5 over the 8-twist alphabet; frozen D3 conjugate-boundary join; extension bound 3; canonical word equivalence; support classes 1 vs 2/3. This is a base-level screen, not the population-size-matched D8c2 test. No Penrose, persistence, or physical claim.
entries.comparator: Exhaustive screen in diversity_advantage.py and data/diversity_d8c2a_screen.json; null model replaces ZFA closure with net-action zero.
entries.kill_condition: Any tested length where heterogeneous support has a strictly higher mean K than homogeneous support, or any null/ZFA continuation-set difference (which would reopen a ZFA-specific reading).
